text:
Ravi_CSM: Heads-up: Northbridge is aiming to shift production traffic to their dedicated pool on Wed 14:00 UTC. We need a final capacity plan, autoscale rules, and a validated load-test window. Can owners volunteer?

tanya_sre: I can take capacity + autoscale. Quick ask: customer traffic profile? steady vs spiky?

simon_eng: They've given a profile: steady ~350 rps, short spikes up to ~1.8k rps for 8-12m, median tokens/request ~45, occasional long sessions (seq ~1024) for analytics requests.

elaine_pm: SLA target is p95 <250ms for the interactive flows. They tolerate 10% fallback to cheaper models for batch analytics.

tanya_sre: Ok. Model we will serve is redwood-7B-q8 with seq cap 1024. On our infra that averages ~120 reqs/GPU/s for 45-token requests when batching is decent. For safety I'd propose reserved_quota=5 GPUs and burstable to 10 GPUs.

simon_eng: math check: 350 rps /120 ~= ~3 GPUs sustained. Spikes 1800 /120 ~= 15 GPUs. Given autoscaling latency, reserving 5 and allowing scale to 12 sounds prudent.

tanya_sre: Proposal: reserved=5, autoscale_min=5, autoscale_max=12. Scale-up trigger: queue_length > 60 for 30s OR p95 latency >220ms for 60s. Scale-down trigger: p95 <150ms for 3m and queue_length < 20.

Ravi_CSM: Fallback behavior? Customer asked for seamless degradation instead of errors.

simon_eng: We can implement a two-tier fallback: 1) model_split: when queue_length >150 route 25% to redwood-3B for interactive-lite; 2) if >300 or 5xx>1% route to hosted-fallback pool. We'll log and tag traces.

glen_oncall: I'll take oncall for the rehearsal. Suggest a rehearsal run Thu 11:00 UTC (30m smoke + 40m soak) and a full rehearsal Tue 13:00 UTC (2h soak + 3x12m bursts). Which is better for customer?

Ravi_CSM: Customer prefers Tue 13:00 UTC for the full run. They can provide an isolated test endpoint and API key.

opsbot: reserved_quota request received: allocated 5 GPUs to northbridge-pool (request id rq-4632).

elaine_pm: We also need quality checks during the soak. Can we sample 100 responses every 5 minutes, run similarity against golden set and flag >0.15 drop in cosine? Also capture hallucination rate on 20 critical prompts.

simon_eng: I'll wire an eval webhook that writes to s3://northbridge-evals/run_1765554322. Similarity threshold 0.15, hallucination flag if answers diverge on named-entity extraction for those 20 prompts.

tanya_sre: Load test plan: I'll author vegeta scenarios to match steady+burst shapes. Example commands: `vegeta attack -targets=steady.targets -rate=360 -duration=20m | vegeta report` then `vegeta attack -targets=burst.targets -rate=1800 -duration=12m`. We'll include a KV pre-warm phase: `vegeta attack -rate=100 -duration=10m warm.targets` to prime caches.

glen_oncall: Please add a runbook snippet for graceful rollback. My rollback trigger: sustained p95 >450ms for 10m OR >2% 5xx. Action: shift traffic to hosted-fallback and run quick A/B rate-limiter.

Ravi_CSM: I'll inform the customer and ask them to quiesce non-test traffic during the window. Also I'll grant their infra lead Viewer+Capacity in the Console.

elaine_pm: Can we expose reserved vs used in the Console and add a note about autoscale headroom? Product will show a recommended renewal quota post-run.

simon_eng: I'll post a PR that surfaces pool usage under Northbridge -> Capacity -> Allocations and include headroom calc.

opsbot: smoke-check: staging health OK, model loads x3, KV cache readiness passed.

tanya_sre: Owners summary: tanya (quota+autoscale), simon (fallback + eval hook), glen (oncall + rollback), ravi (customer comms + permissions), elaine (quality & PM).

glen_oncall: I'll schedule the rehearsal Tue 13:00 UTC and invite infra lead + SRE.

Ravi_CSM: Thanks all. After the run we'll capture observed p95, 5xx, fallback rates, and a recommended reserved quota for the renewal (likely 6-8 GPUs depending on measured burst efficiency). Reconvene post-run for final sign-off. :white_check_mark:
